note: Input bytes interpreted as uint32_t array of code points forming domain with xn-- label
Content after xn-- prefix converted to UTF-8 for punycode decode; contains trailing delimiter
Off-by-one: check uses > instead of >= allowing b == max_out, so max_out basic chars are copied filling output buffer completely
Heap-buffer-overflow: copies b == max_out basic chars to output array of max_out elements, then main decode loop processes delimiter as encoded digit causing additional write
